qa-29Ya.title: Stadium: black and white stripes, tent roof
qa-29Ya.summary: A stadium with black and white horizontal stripes and a tent-shaped roof.

qa-A1pX.title: Stadium: grey diamond-pattern cladding
qa-A1pX.summary: A stadium covered in large grey panels with a diamond pattern, in Education City.

qa-Bcaj.title: Sign: crossing sign with man in long white robe
qa-Bcaj.summary: Pedestrian crossing signs show a man wearing a thobe, the long robe worn by Gulf men.

qa-DTBf.title: Google car: long antenna
qa-DTBf.summary: A long antenna on the car is mostly seen in the south-west.

qa-F3sC.title: Google car: blurred white pickup, left antenna
qa-F3sC.summary: The car is usually blurred, leaving only an antenna on the left and a sliver of the white pickup truck. Rusty clips show on the roof crossbar.

qa-IL8W.title: Mall: boxy building covered in ads
qa-IL8W.summary: A boxy shopping mall with many adverts on its walls and big car parks beside it, in the Rawdat Al Jahhaniya district.

qa-IrTG.title: Street sign: brown, often ground-fixed
qa-IrTG.summary: Brown street signs, often fixed low in the ground, are seen in Education City.

qa-IvYr.title: Pole: round, three insulators, diagonal braces
qa-IvYr.summary: A round pole with three insulators on top, the middle one slightly higher. The crossbar is held by two diagonal braces.

qa-KtSR.title: Structure: gahfiya shape near a stadium
qa-KtSR.summary: A structure shaped like a gahfiya (a traditional woven cap) stands by a stadium in the Rawdat Al Jahhaniya district.

qa-QWts.title: Google car: fairly long antenna
qa-QWts.summary: A fairly long antenna points to the capital and the area around it.

qa-Rdpp.title: Google car: black box on the left of the bed
qa-Rdpp.summary: A black box on the left side of the truck bed points to the green area southeast of Ar-Rayyan. It is not always visible.

qa-WcSv.title: Bollards: only on a few roads
qa-WcSv.summary: Bollards exist only on a few roads, each recognisable. One has black and yellow centre lines, one is greener and overcast, and one is coastal with shrubs. Anything else, guess the long north-south road.

qa-XQGn.title: Chevron: white on red or blue
qa-XQGn.summary: Curve-warning chevrons are white arrows on a red or a blue background.

qa-ZpMs.title: Road lines: solid white edges
qa-ZpMs.summary: Solid white lines at the edges, with a white or yellow line in the middle. Yellow edge lines also exist but are rarer.

qa-azNo.title: Google car: black box on the right of the bed
qa-azNo.summary: A black box on the right side of the truck bed points to Al Khor, and to the green area around the Torch Tower and a large stadium. It is not always visible.

qa-eMIV.title: Street sign: numbered zones
qa-eMIV.summary: Street signs show a zone number, because the country is split into numbered zones inside municipalities. Learn which numbers sit where.

qa-eekc.title: Tower: tallest, hourglass-shaped
qa-eekc.summary: The tallest building in the country, with a curved hyperboloid (hourglass) shape. It is visible from almost anywhere in the Baaya district.

qa-hMwr.title: Towers: four, twisted like a screw thread
qa-hMwr.summary: Four towers that look like a screw thread, visible from almost everywhere in the new city of Lusail.

qa-jmFE.title: Stadium: golden bowl shape
qa-jmFE.summary: A big stadium shaped like a golden bowl, in the new city of Lusail.

qa-kekJ.title: Stadium: twin arches like an open mouth
qa-kekJ.summary: A stadium with two arches shaped like a wide open mouth.

qa-lm-17.title: Google car: white pickup, left antenna
qa-lm-17.summary: A desert with a blurred pickup and an antenna on the left. UAE and Oman pickup coverage looks similar, but the antenna is in the middle there.

differs.how: Antenna sits in the middle of the pickup
Antenna sits in the middle of the pickup

qa-sO5C.title: Coverage: nearly every main road
qa-sO5C.summary: Almost every main road and some side roads are covered. Only the south and the west have no coverage.

qa-sRjs.title: Coverage: World Cup banners
qa-sRjs.summary: Some coverage was shot before the 2022 World Cup, so many banners mention the event.

qa-swZh.title: Plate: long white with maroon strip
qa-swZh.summary: Cars have long white plates with a maroon strip on the left. Trucks have square black plates and police plates are blue.

qa-tm4B.title: Coverage: tripod inside airport and plane
qa-tm4B.summary: A tripod captured the inside of the main airport, and a unique tripod also covered the inside of a plane there.

qa-unhN.title: Landscape: flat sandy desert
qa-unhN.summary: Flat, dry, sandy land stretching far, with very few trees or other greenery.

qa-wBgz.title: Google car: very short antenna
qa-wBgz.summary: A very short antenna on the car points to the north of the country.

qa-wSQQ.title: Google car: cardboard box on the right of the bed
qa-wSQQ.summary: A cardboard box on the right side of the truck bed points to Lusail. The box is not always visible, so check other clues.

qa-xFsU.title: Road: black-tiled surface
qa-xFsU.summary: Roads covered in black tiles are found in Education City.
